rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for unexpectedly meeting someone or coming across something.

example.english: I often encounter former classmates on this street.
example.traditional: 我成日喺呢條街遇到以前啲同學。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 hai2 ni1 tiu4 gaai1 jyu6 dou3 ji5 cin4 di1 tung4 hok6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice for unexpectedly bumping into a person or coming across something by chance.

example.english: I sometimes encounter a former colleague on the bus.
example.traditional: 我有時搭巴士會撞到以前個同事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 si4 daap3 baa1 si2 wui5 zong6 dou2 ji5 cin4 go3 tung4 si6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a meeting, including an unplanned or unexpected one.

example.english: I had an unexpected encounter with an old classmate at the market yesterday.
example.traditional: 我噚日喺街市同舊同學碰面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 si5 tung4 gau6 tung4 hok6 pung3 min6

rows.note: Use this for an encounter that involves hostility, violence, or a clash.

example.english: A hostile encounter broke out outside the stadium.
example.traditional: 球場外面發生咗一場衝突。
example.jyutping: kau4 coeng4 ngoi6 min6 faat3 sang1 zo2 jat1 coeng4 cung1 dat6

rows.note: Use this formal term for a sexual encounter when you do not mean specifically a one-night stand.

example.english: The report states that the victim had a sexual encounter with the suspect.
example.traditional: 報告指出，受害人曾與疑犯發生性接觸。
example.jyutping: bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1 sau6 hoi6 jan4 cang4 jyu5 ji4 faan6 faat3 sang1 sing3 zip3 cuk1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a consensual sexual encounter that happens only once, or a one-night stand.

example.english: They had a one-night stand, a single sexual encounter, while travelling.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺旅行途中有過一夜情。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 leoi5 hang4 tou4 zung1 jau5 gwo3 jat1 je6 cing4

rows.note: Use this when the encounter means confronting someone or something face to face.

example.english: I finally had to encounter my opponent face to face.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jiu3 min6 deoi3 go3 deoi3 sau2

rows.note: Use this when the parties actually engage one another in a fight or armed conflict.

example.english: The two boxers encounter each other in the final round.
example.traditional: 兩個拳手喺最後一回合交手。
example.jyutping: loeng5 go3 kyun4 sau2 hai2 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 wui4 hap6 gaau1 sau2
